createDescription: Create a global account with platform employment. Department, posts and roles may remain unassigned.
description: Manage platform employment, departments, posts and roles.
disableDescription: Disabling revokes platform roles and leaves the global account and tenant memberships unchanged.
employmentBoundary: Disabling or restoring affects platform employment only. Restoring does not restore revoked roles.
enableDescription: Restore platform employment. Revoked roles must be assigned again.
grantDescription: Select a verified global account without platform employment, then assign its profile and roles.
invalidName: Enter a name between 1 and 200 characters.
invalidPassword: Use an initial password between 12 and 128 characters.
name: Name
nameOnly: Only the account name can be edited here. Email changes require the account owner’s verification. Department and posts are profile information.
removeDescription: Remove platform employment and role assignments. The global account and tenant memberships remain.
resetDescription: Send a verification email so the account owner can reset their password.
rolesDescription: Permissions from active roles are combined. Departments and posts do not grant data access.
title: Employees
unlockDescription: Clear this account’s password failure count and lock shared by platform and tenant login. Existing sessions are unaffected.
verifiedAtCreation: Use at least 12 characters. Email is verified at creation. Share the initial password through a secure channel.
